how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-red-cloud-mesa-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:747:obj:0: Grull Hawkwind in ⟦E1⟧ wants you to bring him 7 Plainstrider Feathers and 7 pieces of ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:747:details:0: You have a promising air about you, and will prove yourself to the tribe. Perhaps someday soon you will be welcomed into the great city of ⟦E3⟧. But before that can happen you must prove yourself to my father, Chief Hawkwind.

rows.quest:752:obj:0: Chief Hawkwind wants you to search for his mother near the water well to the southeast of ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:752:details:0: All members of the tribe share in the harmony of life. We live together and work together.
rows.quest:752:details:1: Our commitment to one another carries with it a high degree of responsibility. I ask of you now a humble task.
rows.quest:752:details:2: My mother set out this morning to fetch water from the well to the southeast of Narache. It has been quite some time now. Perhaps you could check on her for me while I attend to tribal matters here?
rows.quest:752:completion:0: You traveled all this way just to help an old woman? My my, aren't you a keeper?
rows.quest:750:obj:0: Grull Hawkwind in ⟦E1⟧ wants you to bring him 10 Mountain Cougar Pelts.
rows.quest:750:details:0: A tauren skilled in the ways of the hunt knows that his prey is not for mere trophy. The beasts of the plains provide us with a means of survival. You will make quite an impression on the elders if you can bring back some highly valued Mountain Cougar Pelts. You can find the beasts lurking in the hills to the south.
rows.quest:750:details:1: Our children need clothing and our tents need mending.
rows.quest:750:progress:0: If you can provide pelts for the tribe I will pass word along to my father, Chief Hawkwind, of your generous deeds.
rows.quest:750:completion:0: The ⟦E4⟧ of Narache thank you for these provisions, ⟦3⟧. With your skill in the ways of the hunt you will surely be ⟦E6⟧ in ⟦E3⟧ someday.
rows.quest:753:obj:0: Take a ⟦E7⟧ from the water well.
rows.quest:753:obj:1: Return the pitcher to Chief Hawkwind in ⟦E1⟧ which is northwest from the water well.
rows.quest:753:details:0: I have traveled many paths through life and these old legs lack the vigor they once had. I can still perform my duties to the tribe. Sometimes it just takes an old woman a little longer to do the task.
rows.quest:753:details:1: But you look like an eager ⟦4⟧. Let's put some of that youthful vitality to the test. Take a water pitcher from the well and bring it to my son, the Chief, in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:753:details:2: Remember that even the most humble task can gain the recognition of elders.
rows.quest:753:progress:0: You look as though you have returned from the plains. Do you have any word from Greatmother Hawkwind?
rows.quest:753:completion:0: You carried this pitcher back at the Greatmother's bidding, I see.
rows.quest:753:completion:1: Your willingness to help others and provide for the tauren of ⟦E1⟧ leads me to believe you would make the tribe proud in ⟦E3⟧ someday.
rows.quest:755:obj:0: ⟦E8⟧ to Seer Graytongue who lives in the hills directly south of ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:755:details:0: Your willingness to perform a humble task for the tauren of Narache and your eagerness to learn are noble traits, ⟦5⟧. I believe one day you will be heralded in ⟦E3⟧ as a ⟦6⟧ of greatness.

rows.quest:755:details:2: The first test is the ⟦E10⟧. ⟦E8⟧ to Seer Graytongue and tell him Chief Hawkwind has sent you.
rows.quest:755:details:3: You will find the seer's abode directly to the south of ⟦E1⟧, tucked away in the hills.
rows.quest:755:completion:0: Chief Hawkwind sent you? Embarking on the ⟦E9⟧ is no small task...
rows.quest:757:obj:0: Kill Bristlebacks in Brambleblade Ravine and bring 12 Bristleback Belts to Chief Hawkwind in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:757:details:0: The ⟦E9⟧ are the steps a young tauren needs to take to gain respect in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:757:details:1: First you must pass the ⟦E10⟧. In this test you must prove your bravery by slaying ⟦E11⟧ of the tribe.
rows.quest:757:details:2: Bristlebacks of Brambleblade Ravine to the east are encroaching on our tribal lands. They ambush our hunting parties and steal from the village by dark.
rows.quest:757:details:3: Show your valor by slaying these villains and return to the Chief in ⟦E1⟧ with their belts as proof of your deeds.
rows.quest:757:progress:0: Have you completed the ⟦E10⟧, ⟦7⟧? I require proof of your valor against the ⟦E12⟧ of our tribe, the Bristlebacks.
rows.quest:757:completion:0: You have passed the first test of the ⟦E9⟧. The tribe will be proud.
rows.quest:780:obj:0: Grull Hawkwind in ⟦E1⟧ wants you to kill Battleboars and bring back 8 Battleboar Snouts and 8 Battleboar Flanks.
rows.quest:780:details:0: ⟦E13⟧ of Brambleblade Ravine to the east are encroaching on our tribal hunting grounds. They are ⟦E14⟧ to be malicious by the Bristleback Quilboars with whom we are at war.
rows.quest:780:details:1: Go and slay the vile creatures and bring back some snouts and flanks so that we can make stew for our young.
rows.quest:780:progress:0: The aggression of the Battleboars is increasing. Have you sent them a clear message and brought back some snouts and flanks yet?
rows.quest:780:completion:0: Most excellent. These ingredients will make a fine stew and the loss of those boars should be a fair lesson to those vile Bristlebacks.
rows.quest:781:obj:0: Bring the ⟦E15⟧ to Chief Hawkwind in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:781:details:0: After carefully evaluating the map, you realize that what you discovered are the plans made by the Bristleback warchief for an extended siege on ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:781:details:1: Surely Chief Hawkwind could use this information!
rows.quest:781:progress:0: You have a look of concern about you, ⟦8⟧. What news do you bring?
rows.quest:781:completion:0: This is quite alarming indeed! But with this information we can call on our brethren from Bloodhoof Village to help thwart the attack. You have saved the lives of many tauren, ⟦9⟧.
rows.quest:763:obj:0: Take the ⟦E16⟧ to Baine Bloodhoof in Bloodhoof Village. Follow the road out of ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:763:details:0: For you to continue with the ⟦E9⟧ you must pass two more tests. It is time for you to broaden your experience, ⟦10⟧.
rows.quest:763:details:1: ⟦E8⟧ to Bloodhoof Village and seek out the Chief, Baine Bloodhoof, son of Cairne. There you may continue your journey and earn the acceptance of the elders of ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:763:details:2: Take this ⟦E17⟧ to Baine. He will recognize my carvings and help you on your path.
rows.quest:763:details:3: Follow the road out of ⟦E1⟧ and travel with haste. Do not stray or you will lose your way.
rows.quest:763:progress:0: What brings you to my village, ⟦11⟧?
rows.quest:763:completion:0: Word from my good friend, Chief Hawkwind! Ah, I can see by his carvings you are of a special breed.
rows.quest:1656:obj:0: Bring the ⟦E18⟧ to ⟦E19⟧ Kauth in Bloodhoof Village.
rows.quest:1656:details:0: ⟦12⟧, please, I beg of you, can you help me? I have not finished my tasks here on the Mesa--I'm in the middle of my ⟦E10⟧--and my father asked me to deliver these furs to the inn in Bloodhoof.
rows.quest:1656:details:1: I'm far from rested enough to complete both my rite and this task for my father. Would you mind going on for me?
rows.quest:1656:details:2: The inn is pleasant and a perfect place to rest during your long travels. I'm sure you'll agree once you see it.
rows.quest:1656:progress:0: Yes, young one? What can Kauth do for you?⟦13⟧⟦14⟧The journey here from the Mesa can be a tremendous burden for some, but a welcome sight for others. Which is it for you, I wonder?
rows.quest:1656:completion:0: Ah, the furs I was expecting. Thank you.
rows.quest:1656:completion:1: These came faster than I had expected. They will make good blankets for anyone who wishes to stay here.
rows.quest:1656:completion:2: Please feel free to stay as long as you like. My inn is always open and all of our people are welcome here. And don't underestimate a good night's rest, it can make a great difference while you're out traveling.
rows.quest:3376:obj:0: Bring the head of Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle to Brave Windfeather in Red Cloud Mesa.
rows.quest:3376:details:0: ⟦15⟧ - I have heard of you, newcomer. Perhaps it is you that will help us, where others have failed.
rows.quest:3376:details:1: We tauren have carved a home out of this land, but not without a cost. The Bristleback quilboars of Brambleblade Ravine, led by Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle, have made our lives difficult with their continued war against us. I charge you to bring me the chief's head!
rows.quest:3376:details:2: He will be found in the ravine to the east in their makeshift village.
rows.quest:3376:progress:0: Sharptusk will trouble us no more once you have brought me proof of his death.  It is his head that I seek, ⟦16⟧.⟦17⟧⟦18⟧We tauren live for the hunt, and there is no greater hunt than against one that is cunning enough to perhaps hunt us back.  If you are successful in this task, young one, you will start to learn what I mean.
rows.quest:3376:completion:0: Justice has been served on this day by your swift actions, ⟦19⟧. Let this deed serve as a warning to all who would threaten our home.
rows.quest:3376:completion:1: You have earned this reward to help you on your sojourn, young ⟦20⟧.
